title: When the Radiators Sings
author: Vesper Voss
blurb: Juniper Sandoval, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
